contracts.README.md: Version utilities parse strict three-part nonnegative decimal versions, without leading zeros, with safe-integer components. Invalid input throws INVALID_VERSION. compareVersions returns -1/0/1; highest returns greatest version or null for an empty list without mutating input. plan(dependencies,registry) returns {name,version} entries in dependency order; registry maps package names to version-string arrays. Public exports are src/index.mjs.

baseline.src/compare.mjs: import {parseVersion} from './parse.mjs';export function compareVersions(a,b){const x=parseVersion(a),y=parseVersion(b);for(const key of ['major','minor','patch'])if(x[key]!==y[key])return x[key]<y[key]?-1:1;return 0;}
baseline.test/public.test.mjs: import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {parseVersion,compareVersions,highest,plan} from '../src/index.mjs';test('ordinary versions and planner',()=>{assert.deepEqual(parseVersion('1.2.3'),{major:1,minor:2,patch:3,pre:[]});assert.equal(compareVersions('1.0.0','2.0.0'),-1);assert.equal(highest(['1.0.0','2.0.0']),'2.0.0');assert.deepEqual(plan([{name:'a'}],{a:['1.0.0']}),[{name:'a',version:'1.0.0'}]);});
